instructions.name: bind_chainling
docs: Publishes one Chainling Archive and atomically consumes its cover plus the selected
Stamped move or cosmetic skin Core asset.

instructions.name: consume_encounter_randomness
docs: Marks fulfilled bytes consumed exactly once after the game has read them.

instructions.name: create_ram_reservation
docs: Creates the shared entitlement reservation required by every production RAM spend.
The result authority pays for and controls the reservation; the player cannot mint one.

instructions.name: credit_purchased_ram
docs: Credits verified purchases without touching earned-RAM counters or the daily cap.

instructions.name: debit_reserved_ram
docs: Retires on-chain purchasing power before a profile-native gameplay mutation settles.

instructions.name: fulfill_encounter
docs: MagicBlock callback. The scoped identity injected by `vrf_callback` proves the caller.

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

instructions.name: grant_ram
docs: Credits RAM under the configured daily cap. Profile creation intentionally grants zero;
only the pinned result authority can authorize a grant, and the receipt makes retries unique.

instructions.name: prepare_profile_stamp_ticket
docs: Records a Stamp ticket for a profile-owned Known move. The Known exists
only in the authenticated Postgres profile until this wallet-signed
transaction creates the Core asset; no wallet MoveVault row is required.

instructions.name: prepare_stamp_ticket
docs: Result-authority/VRF crank records the immutable modifier result. The owner wallet
performs the actual Stamp in a later atomic transaction.

instructions.name: reconcile_ram_delta
docs: Applies a one-time operator-approved delta for a frozen legacy reconciliation case.

instructions.name: request_encounter
docs: Requests base-layer MagicBlock VRF randomness for one bounded request seed.

instructions.name: roll_known_move
docs: Authoritative Academy roll. The player wallet is not a signer: the result authority
writes one zero-modifier Known instance and an immutable replay receipt.

instructions.name: stamp_known_move
docs: Atomically consumes one Known instance and RAM and creates its Stamped Core asset.

instructions.name: stamp_profile_known_move
docs: Atomically turns a profile-owned Known into a wallet-owned Core asset.
Postgres is the canonical RAM ledger for this path, so the program only
requires the wallet signature and the result-authority-issued ticket.
